headline: SKIL Infrastructure Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: SKIL Infrastructure Limited has initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company informed the NSE of compliance filings for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 relating to its insolvency proceedings.
detail: SKIL Infrastructure Limited formally notified the National Stock Exchange of India of its entry into the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process on 29 July 2026. The NSE filing dated 29 July 2026 16:15 IST addresses compliance obligations for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. As an infrastructure company undergoing CIRP, SKIL is subject to the statutory framework under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, which mandates disclosure to stock exchanges and creditors. The filing confirms the company's status and ongoing resolution proceedings.
